meta.notes: The app tags it "YUANDAO DSP Device" and files it under YUANDAO; it is sold as a NiceHCK product, so that is its brand here. Its official presets: 1 Default, 2 Tears, 3 Balanced, 4 Rock, 5 Game (game mode), 6 Sleep (sleep mode), 8 bands each, pre-gain 0. Sleep mode on writes preset 6 and off writes the preset that was on before; there is no mode command. Like the PureAural it leaves stale bytes in its answers, so the app shows its firmware (0.4) as "0.".
